title: Bugs per 100 commits, by size of the change
reading: Each bar is a rate: bugs fixed in the three weeks that trace back to commits of that size, per 100 such commits made since 10 September. The four sizes cover every commit.

title: Bugs per 1,000 files changed, by size of the change
reading: The same bugs, divided by the total number of files those commits changed instead of by the number of commits.
